title: Will MAGA Inc. report more than $325M in cash on hand at the end of Q3? Above $325M
rules: If MAGA Inc.'s cash on hand is above $325 million as of September 30, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: This market resolves based on the official filing data released by the Federal Election Commission (FEC). Only the first official or non-preliminary release of the relevant statistic will be used to resolve the market, and subsequent revisions, corrections, or updates will not affect resolution.

blind.reasoning: MAGA Inc. had $415.8M at the end of August after raising $23.7M and spending only $11.4M that month. To end September at $325M or less, it would need to spend or transfer roughly $110M gross in one month, about ten times its August pace. The September spending made public so far, including $15M on the Texas Senate race, is small, though Trump's pledge of $400–500M for the midterms leaves room for large late-September transfers.
blind.falsifier: The October monthly FEC report (covering September) shows transfers to allied super PACs or prepaid ad buys of about $100M or more, pushing cash on hand to $325M or below.

final.reasoning: The market midpoint of 0.81 nearly matches my 0.82 estimate, so the price does not change my view. With a 0.77/0.85 spread, buying YES at 0.85 or NO at the 0.77 bid would both be negative expected value.
